Seeds and deletes its own 'page-probe actions' bookmarks and clips. Run by bookmarks-page-probe.mjs.

steps.name: the admin's 'page-probe actions' bookmarks of an earlier run deleted, with their clips (200 a request until none is left)
steps.script: let n = 0; for (let round = 0; round < 10; round++) { const r = await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/Query', { searchTerm: 'page-probe actions', limit: 200 })); const ids = r.Items.map(b => b.Id); if (!ids.length) break; n += ids.length; await ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'POST', url: ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/BulkDelete'), data: JSON.stringify({ Ids: ids, DeleteClips: true }), contentType: 'application/json', dataType: 'json' }); } return n;

steps.name: seed: an unnamed point bookmark with a note (A), a named range with a Fast clip (B), a named point (C), a second named range with a Fast clip (D)
steps.script: const T = 10000000; const post = (body) => ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'POST', url: ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks'), data: JSON.stringify(body), contentType: 'application/json', dataType: 'json' }); const a = await post({ ItemId: __vars.movieId, StartTicks: 15 * T, Note: 'page-probe actions point' }); const b = await post({ ItemId: __vars.movieId, StartTicks: 30 * T, EndTicks: 34 * T, Name: 'page-probe actions range' }); const c = await post({ ItemId: __vars.movieId, StartTicks: 40 * T, Name: 'page-probe actions named' }); const d = await post({ ItemId: __vars.movieId, StartTicks: 50 * T, EndTicks: 52 * T, Name: 'page-probe actions second' }); for (const id of [b.Id, d.Id]) { await ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'POST', url: ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/' + id + '/Clip'), data: JSON.stringify({ Mode: 'Fast' }), contentType: 'application/json', dataType: 'json' }); } const files = {}; for (const id of [b.Id, d.Id]) { for (let i = 0; i < 240; i++) { const x = await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/' + id)); if (x.Clip && x.Clip.Status === 'Completed' && x.Clip.FileName) { files[id] = x.Clip.FileName; break; } if (x.Clip && x.Clip.Status === 'Failed') throw new Error('the clip failed: ' + x.Clip.Error); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 500)); } if (!files[id]) throw new Error('the clip did not complete'); } return { a: a.Id, b: b.Id, c: c.Id, d: d.Id, files };

steps.name: the resource timings cleared and widened (the 205 seeds filled the browser's buffer of 250), the clock
Delete: the progress line's texts while the batches go (recorded by a MutationObserver)
steps.script: const p = document.querySelector('.jfbm-backdrop .jfbm-panel'); const line = p.querySelector('.jfbm-bulk-progress'); const seen = []; const note = (records) => { for (const r of records) { const texts = r.type === 'characterData' ? [r.target.data] : [...r.addedNodes].map(n => n.textContent); for (const t of texts) if (t && seen[seen.length - 1] !== t) seen.push(t); } }; const observer = new MutationObserver(note); observer.observe(line, { childList: true, characterData: true, subtree: true }); [...p.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-actions button')].find(b => b.textContent === 'Delete').click(); const until = performance.now() + 15000; while (performance.now() < until && document.body.contains(p)) await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 20)); note(observer.takeRecords()); observer.disconnect(); return { seen, closed: !document.body.contains(p), last: line.textContent };

clean-up: the remaining 'page-probe actions' bookmarks deleted (200 a request until none is left)
steps.script: let ids = 0; let deleted = 0; for (let round = 0; round < 10; round++) { const r = await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/Query', { searchTerm: 'page-probe actions', limit: 200 })); const batch = r.Items.map(b => b.Id); if (!batch.length) break; ids += batch.length; const x = await ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'POST', url: ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/BulkDelete'), data: JSON.stringify({ Ids: batch, DeleteClips: true }), contentType: 'application/json', dataType: 'json' }); deleted += x.Deleted.length; } return { ids, deleted };
